title: kith-chat: Message/get and Message/set update
description:
What: Implement Message/get and Message/set update (patch readAt) JmapHandler structs in kith-chat crate.

Message/get algorithm:
1. Deserialize args: { accountId, ids: Option<Vec<String>>, properties: Option<Vec<String>> }.
2. Verify accountId.
3. Acquire store lock.
4. If ids is None: return invalidArguments ('ids required for Message/get in v1').
   If ids is Some: for each id call store.messages().get(id)?; partition found/notFound.
5. state = store.messages().get_state()?
6. Return { accountId, list: [Message...], notFound, state }.

Message/set update algorithm (readAt patch only for v1):
1. Deserialize args: { accountId, update: Option<Map<String, Value>> }.
2. For each update entry (server_id → patch):
   a. Load message: store.messages().get(server_id)?; if None → notUpdated/notFound.
   b. Extract patch field readAt (String, RFC 3339). Only readAt is patchable in v1; other fields → notUpdated/invalidArguments('cannot patch field X').
   c. Validate readAt parses as valid RFC 3339 UTC timestamp.
   d. Call store.messages().update_read_at(server_id, unix_ts)?
   e. Add to updated map.
3. newState = store.messages().get_state()?
4. Return { accountId, oldState, created: {}, updated, destroyed: [], notCreated: {}, notUpdated, notDestroyed: {}, newState }.

Defensive programming rules:
- Message/get: ids=None is rejected (unbounded list not supported in v1 — too expensive).
- Message/set update: only readAt patchable; any other field key → notUpdated/invalidArguments.
- readAt RFC 3339 parse: use chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339; reject malformed.
- Never use client-supplied readAt for ordering — it goes into the readAt column for display only.
- Cross-chat access: Message/get returns message regardless of chatId (owner can get any message by ID since there is only one account). No cross-user risk.
- Store lock released before returning.

Agent team:
- Agent R: Read kith-store/src/message.rs (get, update_read_at, get_state), kith-core/src/message.rs (Message struct serde field names).
- Agent I: Implement MessageGetHandler and MessageSetUpdateHandler in kith-chat/src/message.rs.
- Agent T: Oracle: RFC 8620 §5.1/5.3 response field names, Message struct serde names from kith-core.
- Agent V: cargo test -p kith-chat && clippy && fmt.

Tests:
- Message/get known id → correct Message fields (body, chatId, senderId, receivedAt, readAt=null)
- Message/get unknown id → notFound list
- Message/set update readAt valid RFC 3339 → updated, message.readAt set
- Message/set update with non-patchable field → notUpdated/invalidArguments
- Message/set update malformed readAt → notUpdated/invalidArguments
